reviewPolicy: All staged creature afflictions in the Howl of the Wild menagerie were reviewed. Creature-affliction levels follow the source creature level when no separate level is printed. Omitted source stage intervals are preserved rather than inferred. Creature poisons are not flagged as alchemical injury poisons. Non-staged poison/disease-trait abilities are tracked as reviewed exclusions rather than forced into the affliction engine.
